resources.string: Unavailable — system did not provide access
Eta main process and observable same-UID processes only. Read-only; no Root required.
Sources: ActivityManager / Debug.MemoryInfo and permitted /proc status/stat. CPU every 1.5 s; PSS and discovery no more often than 6 s. Sampling stops when closed or backgrounded.
PSS shares are additive. RSS may count shared pages repeatedly; RSS sum is not unique physical memory. Totals include available rows only.
PSS can be cached/rate-limited by Android; age is time since request, not guaranteed measurement freshness. Denied/zeroed PSS is unavailable, never a fake zero. No device memory percentage is used.

One logical CPU = 100%; multithreaded totals may exceed 100%. Delta of user + kernel CPU ticks over monotonic awake time; not whole-device normalization. First or restarted processes wait for a second sample.
No reliable public per-app power or GPU attribution is available here. Device battery current, device GPU load and zero are not substituted for Eta measurements.

Not a task count or complete census. UID is verified, never inferred from process names. Isolated/different-UID, Root and Linux-helper processes are excluded. Shared-UID apps cannot be distinguished. Processes may exit between samples.
Some process data or discovery is restricted; the visible subtotal can be incomplete.
